skill.summary: Project manager and task delegation system. Use when you need to break down complex work into smaller tasks, assign appropriate AI models based on complexity, spawn sub-agents for parallel execution, track progress, and manage token budgets. Ideal for research projects, multi-step workflows, or when you want to delegate routine tasks to cheaper models while handling complex coordination yourself.

latestVersion.changelog:
TaskMaster 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces an AI-powered project manager for breaking down and delegating complex work.
- Automatically selects and assigns models (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus) based on task complexity.
- Enables spawning of isolated sub-agents for parallel task execution.
- Includes real-time progress tracking, retry/escalation rules, and consolidation of final deliverables.
- Features robust budget management and token cost tracking to optimize project spend.
- Provides advanced controls for custom model assignment, parallel execution, and budget limits.
